statement:
Con la tabla, calcula $\Delta H$ de la reacción C₂H₄(g) + Br₂(g) → C₂H₄Br₂(g).

| Enlace | Entalpía media de enlace / kJ mol⁻¹ |
|---|---|
| H–H | 436 |
| C–H | 414 |
| C–C | 346 |
| C=C | 614 |
| O=O | 498 |
| O–H | 463 |
| C=O | 804 |
| N≡N | 945 |
| N–H | 391 |
| Cl–Cl | 242 |
| H–Cl | 431 |
| Br–Br | 193 |
| C–Br | 285 |
explanation: Rotos: C=C y Br–Br, $614 + 193 = 807$. Formados: C–C y dos C–Br, $346 + 2 \times 285 = 916$. $\Delta H = 807 - 916 = -109\,\text{kJ}$.
